50 Claude Agents Run an Entire Finance Function End to End

Get access for Free👇 

50 specialized agents that read the macro regime, model valuations and transactions, construct portfolios, price and hedge risk, run finance operations, and enforce governance from the first market signal to the final investment memo.

1/ Markets & macro agents: Macro Regime Agent, Yield Curve Agent, Interest Rate Strategist, Inflation Nowcasting Agent, FX Carry Agent, Alternative Data Agent, Sentiment Signal Agent, Event-Driven Agent.

2/ Valuation & deal-modelling agents: Earnings Quality Agent, Valuation Model Agent, DCF Scenario Agent, M&A Modeling Agent, LBO Modeling Agent, Capital Structure Agent, Investment Memo Agent.

3/ Portfolio construction & trading agents: Cross-Asset Allocation Agent, Equity Factor Agent, Options Strategy Agent, Greeks Hedging Agent, Portfolio Optimizer Agent, Risk Parity Agent, Correlation Regime Agent, Market Microstructure Agent, Execution Cost Agent.

4/ Risk, credit & derivatives agents: Credit Risk Agent, Default Probability Agent, Bond Pricing Agent, Duration Hedging Agent, Liquidity Risk Agent, Volatility Surface Agent, VaR Stress-Test Agent, Tail-Risk Agent, Derivatives Pricing Agent, Structured Products Agent.

5/ Finance operations & planning agents: Treasury Management Agent, Cash-Flow Forecasting Agent, Working Capital Agent, FP&A Scenario Agent, Revenue Forecast Agent, Expense Control Agent, Tax Optimization Agent, Transfer Pricing Agent, Collateral Optimization Agent.

6/ Governance, compliance & performance agents: Regulatory Capital Agent, Basel Compliance Agent, AML Monitoring Agent, Fraud Detection Agent, Counterparty Risk Agent, ESG Risk Agent, Performance Attribution Agent.

This is a full investment function, agentized.
